notes.title: v1.12 (Season 3) - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[p]To coincide with Season 3 going live on September 17, the latest title update will be made available for F1® 25, adding a handful of new and exciting features as well as an improvement to computer-controlled (AI) drivers in all weather conditions.

Patch v1.12 will begin rolling out at 10am UTC on Monday, September 15. Please ensure your PC or console is connected to the internet in order to receive the update. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/5faba1abe877abbf73b033a5cd6d346d5b18d4a3.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]New Features and Season 3 Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Available Sep 15[/h2][list][*][p]Addition of F2™ 2025 including all cars, teams, and drivers[/p][/*][*][p]‘Sports Update’ for F1® 2025 cars, teams, and drivers featuring a number of visual updates and sponsor changes[/p][/*][*][p]‘Computer-Controlled Drivers (AI) Update’ and all other bug fixes mentioned below[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Available Sep 17[/h2][list][*][p]Season 3 updates, including refreshed Podium Pass tiers and Podium Pass Store items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Available Sep 18[/h2][list][*][p]Second Driver Ratings update based real-world results from Belgium to Italy (Monza)[/p][/*][/list][p]To read more about the new features coming alongside this patch and what to expect in Season 3, head to our dedicated blog post on Wednesday.
[/p][h1][b]v1.12 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][h1]Computer-Controlled Drivers (AI) Update[/h1][list][*][p]AI behaviour has been updated so that they can brake later into and accelerate less effectively out of turns. In Dry conditions this will not affect overall lap time, but in the Wet they will be slightly slower[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Following extensive internal testing and feedback from the broad F1 25 community, this change refines and retunes some of the fundamental racing characteristics of computer-controlled drivers (AI).  

You will now notice that AI race in a more flowing fashion, ensuring that they enter and exit corners closer to how a real-world driver would, whilst carrying a more appropriate amount of speed through corner apexes.  

AI performance in Wet weather conditions has also been taken into consideration. The changes relating to acceleration in particular mean AI performance is now better aligned with how your car is expected to drive in the same track conditions. As a result, lap times for the AI in the Wet are slightly slower, differing on a track and difficulty level basis. 
[/i][/p][previewyoutube="coJjPrFS7TY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]
We believe these refinements better balance the flow of racing between you and the AI. You may find it more difficult to dive-bomb them going into corners, or that the AI's out-of-corner acceleration isn't as strong as before. In Dry conditions, lap times for AI drivers are nearly identical to what they were pre-patch, however, these driving characteristics changes may encourage you to adjust your difficulty setting accordingly.  Please continue to share your feedback following these changes - we look forward to hearing what you think.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Career[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Two Player Career which could cause a crash when transitioning between seasons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Peripherals (Wheels/Controllers)[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with Trueforce not working as intended on the Logitech G923 before unpausing or using a rewind[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Audio[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Race Engineer messages could overlap when resuming from the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Race Engineer messages could overlap during a session[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where subtitles were not shown for some podium commentary lines[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Graphics[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a small amount of light could be incorrectly seen within the cockpit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which was causing some trees at Suzuka to appear incorrect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Splitscreen so the position number for both players is now shown in the correct place[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of minor issues with the placement and appearance of numbers and sponsors in the Decal Editor[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]General stability improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/cebadc5f07c0bbc630182c453b217fd56f21e1dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Check-in with our ‘Engineers’[/b][/h1][p]Whether it’s on the [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en"]EA Forums[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/F1Game/"]r/F1Game on Reddit[/url][/u], or across our [u][url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"]social media pages[/url][/u], thank you for making your voice heard by contributing to the F1® 25 discussion so far.

Be sure to keep an eye on the [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---community-raised-issues-last-update-june-4/12214104"]Community-Raised Issues thread[/url][/u]. This post on the EA Forums serves as the go-to place to stay up-to-date on some of what the development team is working on in relation to bugs and issues raised by you, the community. This thread will be updated regularly between patches. To be notified of these changes, sign-in to the EA Forums and tap the bell in the top-right corner of the post.

If you would like to take the time to log a bug, please do so on our dedicated [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en/ideas/f1-25-bug-reports-en"]Technical Issues & Bug Reports[/url][/u] page on the EA Forums, where a member of our team will get back to you. You can find the best bug reporting process by [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25--how-to-report-a-bug/12211551"]clicking here[/url][/u].

We also have a number of support guides for F1® 25 including a [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25-pc-and-wheel-troubleshooting-guide/12211575"]PC Troubleshooting Guide[/url][/u] and tips for setting up F1® 25 to work in [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---vr-and-triple-screen-setup-tips-pc-only/12266987"]Virtual Reality and Triple Screens on PC[/url][/u]. These can be found in the [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en"]F1® Game Info Hub[/url][/u] on EA Forums.

To keep up-to-date on all the other F1® 25 news, be sure to follow us across social media. Links to these profiles and other useful information can be [u][url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"]found here[/url][/u].  

- James / CM_TGK[/p][p]Social, Community, and Creator Manager @ EA SPORTS / Codemasters[/p]

notes.title: F1® 25 - v1.07 - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[p]As Season Two approaches, the latest F1® 25 patch prepares players and introduces various tweaks and bug fixes.

Patch v1.07 will begin rolling out at 10am UTC on Monday, July 21. Please ensure your PC or console is connected to the internet in order to receive the update. Season 2 starts on July 23, check back then for the full reveal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/efe00d2095e02985668a4ac3821119dd159dc129.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]v1.07 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Increased the cost of R&D Upgrades for the player and AI, to slow the speed of team progression in Career modes[/p][/*][*][p]Regulation Changes in Career modes will now affect more areas and can trigger later,  making it harder for teams to fully adapt before the start of the next season[/p][/*][/list][p][i]These two fixes address a community-raised concern around how quickly stats were being maxed out in Career modes. These changes aim to extend the long-term progression and enjoyment of Career play. The adjustments apply to both existing and new Career saves.[/i]
[/p][list][*][p]Career settings that affect resource and cash rates for both the player and AI now decrease the rate even further when set to "Reduced"[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out a bump in the track surface on the apex of the last turn at Spain[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the Pit Release when the Pit Assist is turned off, to reduce instances of the player waiting longer than necessary in the pit box after a stop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which would cause certain Braking Point & F1® The Movie chapters to fail if Pit Assist was turned off[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New notes.title: F1® 25 - v1.06 - PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
[p]The latest F1® 25 patch headlines enhancements to player car performance, aiming to improve the experience of racing against the AI.  Patch v1.06 will begin rolling out at 10am UTC on Monday, July 7. Please ensure your PC or console is connected to the internet in order to receive the update. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/382d1e5967f889e231083a3eb31cf4d9c72cf416.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]v1.06 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]Made minor adjustments to front ride height and floor friction levels to reduce the effect that underbody scraping has on a player's top speed[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Some players have reported that the computer-controlled opponents (AI) were able to maintain a higher top speed, despite equal or similar performance statistics to their own car. After investigation, it was determined that the underbody of the player car was experiencing greater friction against the track surface than those of the AI cars. An adjustment was made to ensure that the underbody scraping is now the same between the player car and AI cars. We expect this change to allow the player car to reach an appropriate top speed, performing as expected across all circuits and weather conditions.[/i]
[/p][list][*][p]Made adjustments to the automatic gearbox in wet conditions. This will reduce short shifting in higher gears and enable the player to compete more effectively with the AI[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Following improvements made to the automatic gearbox for F1 25, upshifts have been reported to occur too early in wet conditions, overcompensating for changes made for this year’s game. An adjustment has been made so that the player car, whilst at full throttle, will upshift slightly higher than previously, which should improve acceleration out of corners compared to AI competitors. 

[b]Please note that additional improvements to the experience racing against the AI are being considered.[/b] The team would appreciate your feedback on the changes that have been made. That feedback can be shared in a dedicated AI post on the EA Forums which [/i][url="https://forums.ea.com/discussions/f1-25-general-discussion-en/placeholder-post-test/12304243"]can be found here[/url][i]. This post will be locked until the patch is live.[/i] 
[/p][list][*][p]Updated the OpenVR SDK (PC Only)[/p][/*][/list][p][i]An update has been made to the OpenVR SDK that’s used for F1® 25, with the goal of improving the performance of VR overall and reducing occurrences of specific community-raised issues such as head tracking problems that lead to jitter/stutter. The dev team continues to investigate reports and we thank the community for their ongoing support on this topic, whilst welcoming additional feedback on VR after this change. When making reports relating to VR, details that should be included are headset variant, firmware/launcher versions, and how the headset is connected to the PC (USB cable type, port type, motherboard details etc). For additional VR setup/troubleshooting support, please see our dedicated guide which can be [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3059520/announcements/detail/546738448831086813?snr=2___"]found here[/url].
[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue at Bahrain which would cause cars to briefly drop down as they drive out of the garage[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fix to prevent an issue in new Driver Career saves where, under certain circumstances, a team could hire three drivers[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fix to prevent an issue in new Driver Career saves where, under certain circumstances, the player could be left without a contract offer from any team at the end of a season[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue in My Team Career where a team could fail to hire enough drivers for the following season[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Circuits[/h2][list][*][p]Updated Sponsor boards at various tracks[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Added Barilla signage at Bahrain, Imola, Monza, and Texas, Explora branding to signage at Monaco, Canada, and Belgium, as well as LVMH branding to the Las Vegas circuit.[/i]
[/p][list][*][p]Updated the time of day for Qualifying and the Sprint Race at Miami[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various minor graphical issues at various tracks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Vehicles[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with Fernando Alonso's car which could appear incorrect after receiving terminal damage[/p][/*][*][p]Joshua Pearce now has the British flag on his car[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Audio[/h2][list][*][p]Updated the post-race Engineer VO for Ferrari[/p][/*][/list][p][i]In previous years, the Ferrari team had used a ‘robo-voice’ to notify their drivers of certain race-related updates. This year, this has been retired by the team, therefore when racing as Ferrari your engineer will now inform you of these updates as they would when driving for other teams.
[/i][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Driver & My Team Career where the broadcast commentary team could refer to it being the 2025 season after season one[/p][/*][*][p]When the player has low tyre wear the Engineer will now recommend extending the stint instead of coming in for a pit stop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where at the first race of the season, the Engineer could refer to the previous race[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing the "Vehicle Condition" Engineer voice command from working correctly[/p][/*][*][p]The Engineer will no longer inform you that a problem with the DRS is an engine issue[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Customisation[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a number of minor issues with the placement and appearance of numbers and sponsors in the Decal Editor[/p][/*][/list][p][i]These changes include improvements to decal resizing consistencies, flickering decals, and lines appearing where they shouldn’t be. [/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Graphics[/h2][list][*][p]Improved the visual quality in Far Chase camera view when using PlayStation®5 Pro Quality Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on PC which could cause the game to appear incorrectly on some HDR monitors, particularly those supporting FreeSync Premium Pro[/p][/*][*][p]The "Ultra Max" detail preset has been removed from graphics cards which cannot support this preset (PC Only)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) implementation to version 3.1.4[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual quality of various items when shown in the Item Store[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Accessibility[/h2][list][*][p]Added a "Play Preview" button to the Tinnitus Relief Filter in the Accessibility Options menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a number of issues which were caused by using a Rewind while in the pit lane[/p][/*][/list][p][i]These changes avoid rare issues from notes.title: F1® 25 - Community Feedback Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hey racers, 
[/p][p]We hope you're enjoying your time with F1® 25 following the game’s launch at the end of May. Since then, we've seen so many of you jump into your favourite single-player modes, race online, and spend time crafting some truly impressive liveries with the new Decal Editor. We're loving what we're seeing so far, and it looks like you are too.
[/p][p]All the while, the team has been hard at work squashing bugs and investigating issues you've taken the time to report. In case you missed it, the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3059520/view/546737172113262520"]first patch[/url] (v1.03) dropped on June 9 and we have our next patch (v1.04) lined up for June 23. The full patch notes will be shared on June 20 at 3pm UTC.
[/p][p]And we're not stopping there. Between patches, you can track some of the bugs and issues being worked on in the [url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---community-raised-issues-last-update-june-16/12214104"]Community-Raised Issues thread[/url] with several updates every week.
[/p][p]One area the team has focused a lot of attention on for F1® 25 is the single-player racing experience. It’s been great to see videos of the intense battles you’ve been having with the AI across each of the 24 circuits in the game and clearly the work the team put in is paying off. 
[/p][p]With over 100 difficulty options and each AI competitor equipped with unique driving characteristics that require split-second calculations, any adjustments to how these drivers race needs extensive testing. That said, the team is digesting all of the comments and feedback you have about your experience racing alongside computer-controlled opponents to see if and what can be done to make this even better, whilst ensuring any updates enhance the experience for the entire F1® 25 community. This may take some time but we’ll be sure to update you along the way.
[/p][p]Right now though, one thing the team have made adjustments to based on your feedback is how AI drivers perform on race starts, as they were at times a little slow getting off the line. That change will be made [b]alongside the upcoming v1.04 patch[/b], so make sure your reaction times are sharpened!
[/p][p]If you have any feedback you’d like to share on single-player racing behaviours, or anything else for that matter, videos with added context go a long way. As always, the best place for these is on the [url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en"]EA Forums[/url], as this ensures the feedback shared will make its way back to the team.
[/p][p]Thanks so much for your continued support and feedback on F1® 25 so far. Be sure to keep it coming and stay tuned to our [url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"]social channels[/url] and the [url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---community-raised-issues-last-update-june-16/12214104"]Community-Raised Issues thread[/url] for all the latest updates.
[/p][p]Happy racing!
[/p][p]- James / CM_TGK
Community and Creator Manager @ EA SPORTS / Codemasters[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: F1® 25 - Before You Play - Update Graphics Drivers
notes.notes:
[i][b]UPDATE: As of May 30, [url=https://www.amd.com/en/resources/support-articles/release-notes/RN-RAD-WIN-25-5-2-F1-25.html]AMD Adrenalin Edition 25.5.2 is now available[/url], adding support for F1® 25.[/b][/i]

Hey racers,

We know you're all excited to get your hands on the game this week - we can't wait to see what you think. 

In early testing, we have identified that the vast majority of game crashes on PC are resolved by making sure that graphics drivers are up to date. 

So that you have the best possible experience playing the game from lights-out, we recommend making sure this is the case before you load up F1® 25 for the first time. 

[list]
[*]For NVIDIA users please use the latest F1® 25 Game Ready driver (576.52 released May 19th)
[*]For AMD, please use the latest Adrenalin drivers 25.5.2.
[*]For Intel, please use version 32.0.101.6795 [/list]
If you're unsure on how to install the latest drivers, please check this post: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/5799-495F-1F25-D15B

If you have any other technical support issues, please be sure to share them on the [url=https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en]EA Forums[/url] where a member of our team will be able to help you quickly. 

Thank you and happy racing!
